name: W New York Times Square
insider_take: Bold, brash, and brilliantly positioned in the heart of Broadway's theater district, this is where Manhattan's electric energy meets cutting-edge luxury.
whats_special: The W New York Times Square sits directly in the epicenter of the city's most iconic intersection, where over 300,000 people pass daily. The hotel's signature "Living Room" lobby buzzes with celebrity sightings and pre-theater cocktails, while the building itself incorporates actual remnants of the historic Paramount Theatre that once stood here. Floor-to-ceiling windows offer front-row seats to the world's most famous digital billboards and the controlled chaos of Broadway.
pro_tip: Book a Broadway View room on floors 20+ for unobstructed views of the Times Square ball drop location - these rooms are coveted year-round, not just for New Year's Eve.
dont_miss: The rooftop R Lounge offers one of Manhattan's most dramatic skylines views, while being steps from TKTS for last-minute Broadway tickets. The hotel's Blue Fin restaurant sources the freshest seafood in Midtown, and you're literally a 2-minute walk to "Good Morning America's" outdoor studio where you might catch a live taping.
pros: Prime Times Square location with direct theater district access
Vibrant W signature design and modern amenities
Rooftop bar with panoramic city skyline views
24/7 fitness center and comprehensive business facilities
cons: High-energy atmosphere may not suit all travelers
Premium pricing reflects prime Manhattan location
